# CliprAuto

> CliprAuto sells two things. CliprAuto is a machine that runs TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts accounts on the customer's own computer (Mac or Windows): $139, paid once, 5 accounts, no monthly fee. Clipr Website builds a new website for a business from its current site, all pages: free to look at, $199 paid once, no monthly fee to us.

No guarantee of views, followers or sales.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://cliprauto.com/): CliprAuto and Clipr Website in short
- [CliprAuto](https://cliprauto.com/cliprauto/): the machine that runs short-form video accounts on the customer's own computer. One-time purchase for Mac or Windows: $139, 5 accounts
- [Clipr Website](https://cliprauto.com/website/): a new website for your business from your current site, free to look at, $199 once
- [CliprAuto in short](https://cliprauto.com/about/): facts, prices and what we do not do
